description: Re-elect Dr. Arlene Beckles | Georgia State House District 96! For over twenty years, Georgia has been my home. After a distinguished tenure on the Norcross City Council and a productive first term as your State Representative, we have delivered results for District 96. But our work is far from over, and I'm ready to continue fighting for you.
title: Re-elect Dr. Arlene Beckles | Georgia House District 96 | Georgia State House of Representative representing Norcross and Duluth
